## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes, and a test covers the change
- [ ] Targets, keys and examples stay fictional: no real company, product, person or client material
- [ ] Scripts stay local: no network requests beyond the local target, no environment variables or credentials
- [ ] A change to the rules in `SKILL.md` was rerun on the self-test or another blind test, with the result above
